content: Asa Iitateth
Asi biitta bolla darida wode asas macca nayti yelettida;
«Xoossa nayta» geetettiza medheteththati asa macca nayti medho lo7o gididayssa be7idi isttafe ba dooridayta machcho ekkida.
GODAY, «Asi hayqqizaaza; iza layththayka 120 layththafe darenna; hessa gishshas ta Ayanay asa naa bolla mernaas deenna» gides.
He wodenne hessafe guye Xoossa nayti asa macca nayta machcho ekkiin nayti yelettida wode wogga wolqqama asati biitta bollan deettes. Isttika beni wode olas minonne erettida asa.
GODAY he wode biitta bollan diza asaa iitateththi daridayssanne istti ba wozinan qoppizayssi wuri ubba wodekka iita xalala gididayssa be7ides;
GODAY as ha biitta bollan medhdhida gishshas modhettides; ba wozinan keehi seelettides.

Hessa gishshas GODAY, «Tani medhdhida asaa ha biitta bollafe ubbaa dhayssana; asa, mehe, do7a, biittara gooshettiza medheteththatanne kafota dhayssana; ays giikko tani istta medhdhida gishshas mishettadis» gides.
Gido attiin Nohey GODAA sinththan sabettides.
Nohe
Nohey hanidayssi hayssafe kaallidi xaafettides. Nohey xillo asa; izi ba woden diza asaa giddon suure asa; Nohey Xoossara giiga duus de7ides.
Nohey Seeme, Kaamenne Yaafeete geetettiza heedzdzu attuma nayta yelides.
He wode biitta bolla diza asi wuri Xoossa sinththan tunides; biittay wuri makkallan kumides.
Xoossi duge biitta xeellishin biitta bolla diza asay wuri tunidayssa be7ides.
Hessa gishshas Xoossi Nohe, «Tani asa ubbaa dhayssana gays; asa gaason biittay makkallan kumida gishshas tani tumappe asanne biitta bolla dizaaz ubbaa dhayssana.
Hessa gishshas mino miththafe nees markabe keexxa; he markabeza giddon kifile ooththa; histtada soo baggaranne kare baggara shidan meesha.
Markabeza keexxashe iza adussateththi 300 wadha, gomppay 50 wadha, pude dhoqqateththi 133 wadha histta ooththa.
Markabezas kaara medhdha; kaaraappenne godaappe giddon issi wadha gidizaso doya agga; pengeza markabezas millera kessa; markabeza heedzdzu pooqe kessa keexxa.
«Tani saloppe garsan shemppora diza medheteththa ubbaa dhayssanaas ha biitta bollan dhayssa haath yeddiko biittan dizayssi wuri dhayana.
Gido attiin tani nenara caaqettana. Neni, ne machchiya, ne naytinne ne nayta machcheti nenara markabezan gelandeta.
Istti nenara paxa daana mala shemppora diza medheteththa ubbaafe qommon qommon addenne macca nam7u nam7u histtada markabeza giddo gelththa.
Dumma dumma qommo kafotappe, dumma dumma qommo mehetappenne biittara gooshettiza dumma dumma qommo medheteththatappe ubbaafe nam7u nam7u gididi shemppora paxa attana mala neekko yaana.
Qasse neninne nenara dizayti maana mala dumma dumma qommo kath efada markabeza giddo gelththa» gi azazides.
Nohey ubbaaka Xoossi azazida mala ooththides.

footnotes.text: Xoossa nayta gizayssa issi issi birsheththa maxaafati kiitanchchata geettes
